scope: Static reconciliation of the existing final manifest, final inventory, original batch inputs, original completed review reports, and current original PNG/case JSON bytes. No image was opened or reviewed by this audit.

accounting.report_total_open_normalization_scope: Includes current candidates, actually opened design references, and actually opened retained processed sources as the report defines them. It does not turn any source, oracle, panorama, or reference image into another manual case.

reports.normalization_note: actual_original_image_opens is explicitly defined as current candidates only.
